### Critical severity (1)

#### Data inconsistency: objective response rate (ORR) differs across documents

**Type:** data_inconsistency · **Domain:** efficacy · **Status:** open · **Rule:** —

Objective response rate (ORR) is reported inconsistently across sources that share the same comparability dimensions. Values: 42% in Clinical_Study_Report_v1.0.pdf (page 2); 42% in Clinical_Study_Report_v1.0.pdf (page 10); 42% in Clinical_Study_Report_v1.0.pdf (page 11); 42% in Clinical_Study_Report_v1.0.pdf (page 21); 42% in Clinical_Data_Listing.xlsx (page 1); 48.4% in Commercial_Forecast_v1.pptx (page 3). The difference exceeds the 2.0% relative tolerance (counts must match exactly), and both records come from different documents with the same trial/arm, analysis population, data cut-off, endpoint definition and assessment method.

**Possible causes:** Reporting or transcription error in one of the documents; One source was not updated after a re-analysis or data refresh; An unstated population or analysis subset is used under the same label

**Missing information:** Which value represents the final analysis, and the source table / analysis output supporting it; Confirmation of the analysis population, data cut-off and assessment method for each value

**Evidence citations:**

- *Clinical_Study_Report_v1.0.pdf*, page 2 — “Description Study identifier NCT05712345 Phase Phase 2 Indication MTAP-deleted advanced solid tumors Design Open-label, single-arm, Simon two-stage Planned sample size 126 patients Primary endpoint ORR per RECIST 1.1 Data cutoff 2026-01-15 ORR (ITT) 42.0% (53/126) DCR (ITT) 71.4% Median PFS (ITT) 7.1 months Any-grade AE 97.6% Grade >=3 AE 38.1% SAE 19.8% Table 1.” (verified)
